candidates.statement: ∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α} {n : ℕ}, n ≤ l.length → l.rotate' n = List.drop n l ++ List.take n l
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α) (n : ℕ), (l.rotate n).length = l.length
∀ {α : Type u} {l l' : List α} {n : ℕ}, l.rotate n = l' ↔ l = l'.rotate (l'.length - n % l'.length)
∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α} {n : ℕ}, n ≤ l.length → l.rotate n = List.drop n l ++ List.take n l
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α) (a : α) (n : ℕ), (a :: l).rotate (n + 1) = (l ++ [a]).rotate n
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α) (n : ℕ), (l.rotate' n).length = l.length
∀ {α : Type u} (n : ℕ), [].rotate n = []
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α), l.rotate 0 = l
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α) (n m : ℕ), (l.rotate n).rotate m = l.rotate (n + m)
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α) (n : ℕ), l.rotate (n % l.length) = l.rotate n
∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α} {n : ℕ}, n < l.length → (l.rotate n).head? = l[n]?
∀ {α : Type u} (a : α) (n k : ℕ), (List.replicate n a).rotate k = List.replicate n a
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α), l.cyclicPermutations ≠ []
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α), l ≠ [] → l.cyclicPermutations.length = l.length
∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α} {n : ℕ}, l.rotate n = List.drop (n % l.length) l ++ List.take (n % l.length) l
∀ {α : Type u} {l l' : List α}, l ~r l' ↔ l' ~r l

targets.statement: ∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α}, l.Nodup → ∀ {n : ℕ}, l.rotate n = l ↔ n % l.length = 0 ∨ l = []
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α) (n : ℕ), l.rotate n = l.rotate' n
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α) (n : ℕ), (l.rotate n).reverse = l.reverse.rotate (l.length - n % l.length)
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α) (k : ℕ), (l.rotate k).cyclicPermutations = l.cyclicPermutations.rotate k
∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α}, l.Nodup → l ≠ [] → ∀ (i j : ℕ), l.rotate i = l.rotate j → i % l.length = j % l.length
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type u_1} (f : α → α → β) (x y : α) (l : List α), List.zipWith f (x :: y :: l) ((x :: y :: l).rotate 1) = f x y :: List.zipWith f (y :: l) (l ++ [x])
∀ {α : Type u} (l : List α), l.rotate' l.length = l
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type u_1} {γ : Type u_2} (f : α → β → γ) (l : List α) (l' : List β) (n : ℕ), l.length = l'.length → (List.zipWith f l l').rotate n = List.zipWith f (l.rotate n) (l'.rotate n)

candidates.statement: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R) {q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → (p %ₘ q).degree ≤ q.degree
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p q : Polynomial R), p %ₘ q + q * (p /ₘ q) = p
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (p : Polynomial R) (a : R), p %ₘ (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) = Polynomial.C (Polynomial.eval a p)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R), 0 /ₘ p = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, q.degree ≤ p.degree ∧ p ≠ 0 → q.Monic → (p - q * (Polynomial.C p.leadingCoeff * Polynomial.X ^ (p.natDegree - q.natDegree))).degree < p.degree

∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R} [inst_1 : Ring S] (f : R →+* S), q.Monic → Polynomial.map f (p /ₘ q) = Polynomial.map f p /ₘ Polynomial.map f q ∧ Polynomial.map f (p %ₘ q) = Polynomial.map f p %ₘ Polynomial.map f q
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, p.Monic → p ∣ q → q.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree → q = p * Polynomial.C q.leadingCoeff
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {q : Polynomial R} (p : Polynomial R), ¬q.Monic → p /ₘ q = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → (p %ₘ q = 0 ↔ q ∣ p)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {q : Polynomial R} (p : Polynomial R), ¬q.Monic → p %ₘ q = p
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] {p : Polynomial R}, Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a ∣ p ↔ p.IsRoot a
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {x : R}, Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x 0 = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p q : Polynomial R), p %ₘ q = p - q * (p /ₘ q)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] [Nontrivial R] (p : Polynomial R) {q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → (p %ₘ q).degree < q.degree
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R] (p : Polynomial R) (a : R), Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a p = if p = 0 then 0 else multiplicity (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) p
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → q.degree ≤ p.degree → q.degree + (p /ₘ q).degree = p.degree

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R), p /ₘ 0 = 0

∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [NeZero 2] (n : ℤ), n ≠ -1 → (Polynomial.Chebyshev.U R n).degree = ↑((n + 1).natAbs - 1)
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (n : ℤ), Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R (n - 1) = Polynomial.X * Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R n - Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R (n + 1)
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (n : ℤ), Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R (n + 2) = 2 * Polynomial.X * Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R (n + 1) - Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R n

∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R], Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R 1 = Polynomial.X
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (n : ℤ), Polynomial.Chebyshev.C R (n - 2) = Polynomial.X * Polynomial.Chebyshev.C R (n - 1) - Polynomial.Chebyshev.C R n

∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (n : ℤ), Polynomial.eval 1 (Polynomial.Chebyshev.U R n) = ↑n + 1

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (x : R), (1 - x ^ 2) * Polynomial.eval x ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k + 2] (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R n)) = (2 * ↑k + 1) * x * Polynomial.eval x ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k + 1] (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R n)) - (↑n ^ 2 - ↑k ^ 2) * Polynomial.eval x ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R n))
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [NeZero 2] (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.Chebyshev.U R ↑n).degree = ↑n
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (n : ℤ), Polynomial.Chebyshev.U R (n - 1) = 2 * Polynomial.X * Polynomial.Chebyshev.U R n - Polynomial.Chebyshev.U R (n + 1)
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (n : ℤ), Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R (n - 1) = 2 * Polynomial.X * Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R n - Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R (n + 1)
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (n : ℤ), Polynomial.Chebyshev.U R (-n) = -Polynomial.Chebyshev.U R (n - 2)
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (n : ℤ), Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R (-n) = Polynomial.Chebyshev.T R n
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R], Polynomial.Chebyshev.C R 0 = 2
